jobs.occupation: Finance Partner for Financial Planning & Analytics department at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
If you're energised by turning data into valuable insights and thrive on teamwork in a dynamic environment, we'd love to hear from you!

**Who We Are

**We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

**About The Role

**We are looking for a Finance Partner to join our Financial Planning & Analytics DK team. As trusted partners to the organization, we deliver timely, accurate, and data-driven insights that enable informed decision-making and efficient resource allocation.

Our mission is to empower the business to focus on its core responsibilities while driving performance.

In this role, you will leverage advanced analytics, financial modelling, and digital tools to provide actionable insights and collaborate closely with business leaders to shape strategic decisions. We offer a steep learning curve, exposure to advanced analytics and digital tools, and the chance to develop into a trusted partner for the organization, as long as you are curious, proactive, and eager to learn.

Location Denmark - Virum

Experience 0 - 2 years

Department Financial Planning & Analytics

**How You Might Spend Your Days

**As a Finance Partner you’ll be:

• Analysing large datasets and transforming them into meaningful insights that support management decisions

• Driving forecasting, budgeting, and scenario planning using advanced planning tools and BI platforms

• Acting as the primary financial advisor for a VP and managers in the line of business, ensuring clarity and transparency in financial performance

• Optimizing financial processes through automation and digitalization, ensuring efficiency and accuracy

• Participating in rotational tasks across planning, reporting, and performance analysis to broaden your impact and expertise

• Collaborating on data governance and quality initiatives, ensuring reliable inputs for strategic planning.

**Who You Are

**We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are:

• A data-savvy problem solver with great analytical skills and a passion for turning numbers into actionable insights

• Comfortable with complex datasets, able to structure and interpret data to tell a clear story

• A good communicator who can simplify technical findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at all levels

• Proactive, structured, and detail-oriented, while maintaining a strategic overview

• Agile and adaptable, thriving in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities

• A collaborative team player who values knowledge sharing and cross-functional cooperation

**What You Bring To The Role

**In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• M.Sc degree within economics or finance with excellent results

• 1-2 years of experience performing management reporting and planning budget processes.

• Experience in financial systems, BI tools, and data visualization (e.g., Power BI)

• You speak and write English

**Why choose NNE?

**NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer **here .

****Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

****Deadline of application is 18th November 2026

**Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Rasmus Moltved on +45 3077 4638.

**Please note:

**

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

**Fair hiring:

**At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

**Still searching for the right opportunity?

**If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

jobs.occupation: Junior 1st Line IT Supporter for the Nordic team – Copenhagen Area/Malmø (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Ready to take your first step into IT support and learn from experienced colleagues?

At Egmont IT, we are now looking for a Junior 1st Line IT Supporter for our office in Copenhagen Area/Malmø. You will be part of a distributed, close-knit Nordic IT team with colleagues in Sweden, Denmark and Norway.

In this role, you will handle day-to-day IT tickets with support and guidance from experienced colleagues. You will build your technical skills, learn how a professional service desk works and grow into a confident IT supporter. No two days are the same, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience.

Main responsibilities:

- Receive, analyze and resolve incoming IT tickets via the ticketing system, phone and chat, and escalate to 2nd/3rd line when needed.

- Handle standard user administration, permissions and licenses in Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (Azure AD)and Active Directory, following established procedures.

- Provide first-line troubleshooting and support for clients (Windows/macOS), network/VPN, hardware and software.

- Keep users informed and make sure tickets are clearly and correctly documented.

- Help create and update technical documentation and knowledge base (KB) articles.

- Flag recurring problems and suggest ideas for improvements.

- Collaborate with 2nd/3rd line, operations and infrastructure teams in the Nordics.

- Support colleagues on-site in Copenhagen with local issues that cannot be resolved remotely.

We are looking for someone who:

- Has 0–2 years of experience in IT support/Service Desk, or relevant education, internship or student job in IT.

- Has basic knowledge of Microsoft 365, Active Directory/Entra ID, Windows/macOS and networking (e.g. DNS, DHCP, VPN).

Why Egmont?

At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Would you like to be part of the team?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Copenhagen

• Application deadline: November 26, 2026

• Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

If you have any questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Director Rune Hald at rune.hald@egmont.com.

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

jobs.occupation: Senior Manager, Technology & Innovation - Control & Connectivity Solutions
jobs.description:
**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Manager, Technology & Innovation, you will shape the future of control systems used in off-road mobile machinery around the world. Leading a team of Architects and Innovation Engineers, you will define and drive the technology roadmap for next-generation Controllers, Displays, Remote Controls, and Joysticks, helping create the technologies that will power safer, more productive, connected, and increasingly autonomous machines.

This role combines people leadership, technology strategy, system architecture, and innovation. Working across our global Engineering and Portfolio organizations, you will turn customer needs, market trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies into scalable platform solutions that enable future product development. You'll have the opportunity to influence key technology decisions, develop talented teams, and help bring new technologies from early exploration into real-world customer value.

The position is ideally based at one of our Danfoss Power Solutions locations in Northern Europe, with flexibility for other locations where local employment regulations allow.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Define and drive the technology and innovation roadmap for our Control & Connectivity Solutions portfolio, ensuring it supports future product and platform strategies.

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Architects and Innovation Engineers, creating an environment built on collaboration, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

• Own and govern key architecture principles and technology choices for future generations of Controllers, Displays, Remote Controls, and Joysticks.

• Build and manage a technology pipeline that moves ideas from exploration and proof-of-concept through technology maturation and handover into product development.

• Translate customer, market, regulatory, and technology trends into engineering opportunities, working closely with Portfolio Management, Product Management, Engineering, and Procurement teams across the global organization.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience leading and developing technical teams within engineering, technology, innovation, or product development environments.

• Great experience developing embedded and connected mechatronic systems that integrate electronics, embedded software, communication technologies, and mechanical design.

• Expertise in defining technology strategies, system architectures, technology roadmaps, or product platforms for complex products and systems.

• Understanding of functional safety, machinery regulations, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within embedded industrial, automotive, mobile machinery, or similarly regulated environments.

• Ability to collaborate, influence decisions, and build effective relationships across global, cross-functional organizations.

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• You'll lead a highly skilled technical team and influence the technologies and architectures behind future generations of machine control solutions.

• You'll work closely with senior leaders across Engineering and Portfolio Management, giving you visibility and impact on key technology and product decisions.

• You'll gain exposure to emerging technologies and help turn new ideas into scalable solutions used by customers around the world.

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities. You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about, we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're excited by the opportunity to shape technology strategy, lead talented engineers, and help create the next generation of intelligent machine control solutions, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

jobs.occupation: Strategy Director, Global Manufacturing & Supply IT
jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As Strategy Director, Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS) IT, you will help shape strategic priorities and strengthen decision-making across a complex global organisation. Working closely with senior leaders, you will connect business and technology, create alignment across organisational boundaries and turn strategic ambition into clear direction and action.

**What You'll Bring

**We are looking for a strategic partner who fosters trust, align stakeholders, and creates clarity in ambiguous situations. To succeed, you will bring:

• Solid experience supporting senior leaders and leadership teams in a strategic, coordination or business partnering capacity, for example as a Chief of Staff, Senior Business Partner, Executive Assistant, management consultant or strategy professional.

• Strong stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisations, with the ability to align diverse interests and influence outcomes without formal authority.

• A proven ability to influence senior leaders across functions and organizational boundaries, including VP and SVP-level stakeholders.

• Demonstrated experience shaping organizational strategy, operating models and leadership agendas in complex global organizations.

• A proven ability to structure ambiguity, connect competing priorities and translate strategy into actionable plans.

• Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex IT, digital and organisational topics into simple, business-relevant messages that land with senior stakeholders.

• Strong stakeholder intelligence, with the ability to understand what matters to key partners, anticipate concerns and ensure the right people are involved early enough to create alignment.

• Track record of leading strategic transformation initiatives with measurable organizational impact.

• Experience with strategic planning, portfolio prioritization, business case development and investment governance.

• The confidence to act as a trusted sparring partner to the VP, challenging and strengthening thinking, communication and follow-through before key leadership forums.

• A confident approach to using AI to work more effectively and bring modern ways of working.

• Resilience, discretion and a calm, senior presence in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluency in written and spoken English at a professional level.

• A master's degree in economics, business administration, finance or a related business discipline.

**In Addition, It Is Valued If You Have

**

• Experience from large, global matrix organisations such as pharmaceuticals, FMCG or consulting.

• Familiarity with IT or Operational Technology (OT) environments.

**What You'll Do

**You will act as the primary strategic coordination and integration point for the GMS IT Vice President and Leadership Team. The role is about ensuring the VP and Leadership Team operate with focus, clarity and influence, so GMS IT is seen as a strategic business partner across GMS and Enterprise IT. You will:

• Own the strategic planning process for GMS IT, ensuring priorities, investments, organizational capabilities and operating model decisions are aligned with GMS and Enterprise IT objectives.

• Drive continuous improvement of GMS IT leadership effectiveness, governance, decision-making processes and organizational performance.

• Help position the GMS IT Vice President and Leadership Team as a strategic partner by shaping clear narratives, framing dilemmas, preparing decision points and translating priorities into executive messages.

• Anticipate upcoming leadership moments, stakeholder concerns and business planning needs, ensuring the VP and Leadership Team are prepared, aligned and influential in senior forums.

• Represent GMS IT in key cross-functional and enterprise forums, influencing decisions and priorities that impact GMS-wide technology and digital transformation initiatives.

• Actively engage key partners across GMS Business Support and Enterprise IT, ensuring they are brought in early and sufficiently involved in business planning and leadership team discussions.

• Drive the business planning processes in close collaboration with Finance, People & Organisation and other key functions.

• Serve as a member of the GMS IT Leadership Team, driving preparation, follow-up and execution of leadership meetings.

• Provide leadership and direction across the GMS IT Business Partner community, creating alignment and consistency in strategic planning, communications and execution across the organization.

• Develop stakeholder engagement plans and prepare executive-level communications, leadership updates and strategic storylines that make GMS IT’s contribution visible and easy to understand.

• Drive follow-up on key initiatives, ensuring alignment and follow-through across functions and organisational levels.

**Who You'll Work With

**In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to bring molecules, processes, devices and products to the people who need them. You will be part of GMS IT, a global organisation spread across the world, working closely with the GMS IT Vice President and Leadership Team.

Your key partners will include Enterprise IT, GMS Business Support, Finance, People & Organisation, the broader Business Partner network and the Enterprise IT Executive Assistant network. You will need to know these partners well, understand how to bring them into the right discussions at the right time, and use that network to create stronger alignment around GMS IT priorities. You will navigate a complex matrix in a virtual setting with cultural awareness and agility, bringing different perspectives together to create clarity and momentum.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will join an environment where your expertise shapes decisions at the top of a global organisation. The role offers broad exposure across functions and leadership, the chance to influence how a senior leadership team operates and is perceived, and the opportunity to turn complexity into clear direction. You will be supported to perform at your best while working at pace with curious, ambitious colleagues.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 940,800 to 1,448,700 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring clarity, structure and strategic focus to a global leadership team, apply for the role by 15th November.

Ambu is redefining the future of endoscopy with a bold vision to become the global leader in the field. Driven by innovation, we are committed to delivering breakthrough solutions that set new standards for patient outcomes and healthcare efficiency.

We invite you to be part of our journey as we accelerate the development of our next-generation urology portfolio—one of Ambu’s fastest-growing and most dynamic business areas. If you are passionate about shaping impactful, innovative solutions in a rapidly expanding market, this is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the future of urology care.

**Join us in shaping the next generation of Urology solutions

**As our new Global Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving upstream pipeline development project within the urology business area. You will set the commercial direction for new product, ensuring that user and customer needs are central to every stage of development. Success in this role means working closely with R&D, Clinical, Medical Affairs and Sustainability to create strong value propositions and go-to-market strategies that turn innovation into real impact. You’ll join a collaborative team that values creativity and excellence, reporting to the Vice President of Global Product Management Urology in Global Marketing. This role is based in our headquarters in Ballerup.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Act as the commercial lead in new product development projects, setting the strategic direction of your product area to ensure a successful launch.

• Translate customer insights and unmet needs into actionable product and design requirements.

• Lead and facilitate advisory boards and engage with key opinion leaders (KOLs) during development.

• Develop business cases and portfolio scenarios to support strategic decision-making.

• Conduct early-phase market and customer investigations to identify opportunities, user needs, and market potential.

• Drive Launch Excellence by defining clear value propositions, product claims, and messaging frameworks.

• Post-launch, continue to optimize performance through customer feedback, data insights, and lifecycle management

**Suggested Candidate Profile

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• Strong commercial, product management, or clinical experience within MedTech or healthcare.

• Experience from Endoscopy is a prerequisite, additional experience in Urology is a strong advantage

• A track record of leading product innovation projects from concept to launch.

• You have participated in or led innovation projects from early concept to launch, enabling you to balance customer insights, technical considerations, and business priorities.

• Ability to turn complex user needs into clear commercial recommendations, using your strategic mindset and business acumen to drive informed decisions across a global matrix organization

• A master’s degree in healthcare, business, marketing, or a related field.

• Strategic thinking, strong analytical skills, and curiosity about clinical and market trends.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to align stakeholders in a matrix environment.

• Excellent English communication skills and a global outlook.

• Willingness to travel up to 20% to conferences, customer visits, and global subsidiaries.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You’ll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture—where ideas matter, and impact is visible. We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply.

Your application will be treated confidentially.

Are you passionate about developing people and helping leaders succeed? PEAK Wind is seeking a Lead People & Development Specialist to strengthen leadership development, lead larger people initiatives, and provide trusted guidance on complex people matters. This is a senior generalist role for someone who combines hands-on experience with the confidence to turn business needs into practical solutions.

Introducing the People & Development Team

You will become part of our People & Development team, where we work collaboratively to attract, develop, and retain talented colleagues and support the business across the employee lifecycle. We share knowledge, support one another, and bring different perspectives to finding solutions that work for both our people and our business.

You will report to Head of People & Development and work closely with our Senior Management, leaders and colleagues across the business. As an experienced individual contributor, you will take ownership of your areas of responsibility while contributing to the wider team’s priorities.

How You Will Make an Impact

As a Lead People & Development Specialist, you will combine broad generalist responsibilities with a strong focus on leadership development and project delivery. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Support the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of leadership development initiatives, translating leaders’ needs into practical workshops, tools, and follow-up activities.

• Act as a trusted sparring partner to Senior Management and  leaders on team development, performance, collaboration, and day-to-day people decisions.

• Lead larger, cross-functional People & Development projects from scoping and planning through implementation and follow-up, managing stakeholders, dependencies, and communication.

• Handle complex and sensitive employee relations cases with sound judgement, discretion, and a structured approach, involving relevant colleagues or external advisers when needed.

• Contribute across the employee lifecycle, providing pragmatic guidance and supporting consistent people practices, policies, and processes.

• Support annual people processes, including Performance & Development Dialogues and Talent Reviews, helping leaders turn discussions into meaningful development actions.

• Identify opportunities to improve how we work and share your experience with the People & Development team to strengthen our collective delivery.

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

You are an experienced People & Development generalist who enjoys both developing people and navigating the complexity of everyday people matters. You can work independently, build trust with leaders, and balance longer-term development initiatives with hands-on delivery. You will bring:

• A relevant educational background in human resources, organisational development, psychology, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Substantial experience in a broad HR or People & Development role, with the judgement and independence to operate as a senior generalist.

• Hands-on experience supporting leadership development, including facilitating learning activities and helping leaders apply new approaches in practice.

• A track record of leading larger people projects with multiple stakeholders, from defining the need to embedding the outcome.

• Experience handling complex employee relations cases with empathy, confidentiality, and sound judgement, recognising when specialist or legal advice is needed.

• Strong relationship-building and facilitation skills, with the confidence to support and constructively challenge leaders.

• A structured, pragmatic approach and the ability to prioritise competing needs and follow through on commitments.

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, and a collaborative mindset.

• Experience working with Insights profiles in individual or team development is a clear advantage; relevant accreditation is welcome but not required.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to strengthen leadership and people practices in a business supporting the renewable energy transition

• Flexible working arrangements that support both your career and personal life

• A flat organisational structure where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth.

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found. Please apply directly through our website. If you have any questions or would like to know more about the position, please contact People & Development at recruitment@peak-wind.com.

About PEAK Wind

PEAK Wind is an independent renewable energy specialist in commercial, financial, and technical operations, delivering advisory, intelligence, and asset management services to investors and developers around the world. From onshore and offshore wind generation to Power-to-X, we work across the entire energy lifecycle to optimise operations and maintenance, enhance asset performance, and provide a holistic view of renewable infrastructure portfolios.

Our values - Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity - are reflected in everything we do, from how we support our clients to how we collaborate as a team. At PEAK Wind, you will be able to apply your professional skills in a dynamic environment and experience a meaningful responsibility and involvement.

jobs.occupation: QA Specialist, QA Commercial Drug Substance
jobs.description:
Are you experienced in managing CMO collaborations and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders? Do you thrive in a broad QA role where you combine your GMP expertise with a pragmatic and hands-on approach across different quality areas?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new QA Specialist in QA Commercial Operations.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate QA specialist to join our team. You will be a part of the well-functioning QA Drug Substance/QA for QC team in the QA Commercial Operations department, with responsibility for quality oversight of starting materials, intermediates, and Drug Substances for commercial products. We have a close collaboration with our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and process- and QC SMEs internally at Ascendis Pharma.

Your key responsibilities will be:

As part of the role, you will work broadly across quality oversight activities and take ownership of a wide range of tasks and responsibilities, including:

• Take primary responsibility for oversight of one or more CMOs in our supply chains with respect to review and approval of documentation from these CMOs, including upscale activities, PPQ documentation, CPVs, batch documentation, deviations, changes, CAPAs, stability studies, QMRs, quality agreements etc

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key CMO stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and effective collaboration through meetings, teleconferences, and audits. Participate in CMO evaluations and product quality reviews

• Keep up to date with changes in relevant product guidelines and regulatory requirements and ensure cGMP at Ascendis and CMOs

• Drive and assume responsibility for agreed tasks and matters

• Continuously optimize our work processes and the way we execute quality oversight

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a master's degree in pharmacy or equivalent - and 5-10 years of experience within chemical and/or biological GMP production

Furthermore, you have:

• 
Solid QA experience, preferably including QA for QC, and experience working with CMOs

• 
Strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a can-do attitude

• 
Cultural understanding

• 
Experience with audits/inspections

• 
A critical and  pragmatic mindset and yet with attention to the necessary details

• 
Clear and persistent communication skills, particular regarding expectations and requirements to quality

• 
Cooperative and striving for smooth cooperation with many stakeholders

• 
Ambitious and able to see the benefits in going the extra mile

The position as QA specialist requires experience with and knowledge of US and EU GMP regulations and requirements. Furthermore, you should be proficient in English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office.

At Ascendis Pharma, you will be part of a stimulating, informal, and innovative working environment, where you will interact with very skilled colleagues and partners to deliver on Ascendis' ambitious corporate goals. You will be part of an expanding QA-organization overseeing development, clinical, and commercial activities.

Travel: 5-20 days/year.

Place of work: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the job or the company, please contact QA Senior Director, Jan Jakobsgaard, M +45 25 66 29 42 leave a message if call is not answered. All applications must be submitted in English and are treated confidentially.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

**Your impact begins here

**As Sr Manager, LIMS and Ecosystems, you will lead the team responsible for LIMS (Laboratory IT Management Systems) and Ecosystems, giving people clear direction and turning departmental plans into priorities they can act on today. You will build a team that is well staffed, growing and accountable, and work with IT and business partners to secure reliable, compliant delivery. Your impact will be felt in a team that performs consistently and in the colleagues who rely on its work.

**What You’ll Bring

**You are a people leader who sets direction, follows through and keeps teams moving, in a complex and regulated environment.

• A Master’s degree or equivalent relevant education. Substantial relevant experience may compensate for formal education requirements.

• Relevant people-leadership experience, including goal setting, delegation, performance management, development and employee relations.

• Experience leading professional employees and coordinating assignments of medium to high complexity.

• Experience translating departmental plans into operational goals, priorities and follow-up.

• Experience with workforce and capacity planning, recruitment and FTE-related budget management.

• Experience working with IT and business stakeholders in a complex, regulated organisation.

• The ability to communicate clearly, make timely decisions, work independently and handle conflicts and difficult conversations constructively.

• An inclusive mindset that respects different perspectives and reflects The Novo Way.

• Novo leadership training, or willingness to complete the required leadership training.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**Knowledge of laboratory systems, enterprise IT or adjacent regulated-business domains.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the first-line leader for the LIMS and Ecosystems area, accountable for how the team performs, develops and delivers.

• Set clear expectations and goals for the team and each employee, and hold regular one-to-ones, team meetings and performance dialogues.

• Turn LAPS priorities into team plans, milestones and follow-up routines, balancing planned work, operational support and emerging issues based on business impact, risk and capacity.

• Act as hiring manager, plan the team’s future skills and capacity, and ensure structured onboarding, development plans, succession and career conversations.

• Own the team’s FTE-related budget and the system budgets for the area, and recommend adjustments when demand and capacity are not balanced.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working. This is the department of Laboratory and PAT solutions, where colleagues deliver IT solutions and drive digitalization for laboratories and quality control across Novo globally.

You will lead a team of professional employees in LIMS and Ecosystems and take part in the LAPS Leadership Team, aligning priorities, capacity and dependencies with your peer leaders. Day to day, you will work with Product Management, system and solution roles, business representatives and colleagues in EIT (Enterprise IT) and Line of Business to set expectations, share delivery status and resolve issues. HR and finance partners will support you on recruitment, performance, reward, workforce planning and budget.

**Job Description

**

Manager, Strategy & Execution

Posting Start Date: 10/26/26

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution

**

• Location: Copenhagen / Lisbon

• Work model: Hybrid / Full time

• Contract type / duration: Permanent

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

**What Your Day Will Look Like

**As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

• Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days

• Developing a methodology to define future market roles

• Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency

• Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period

• Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board

• Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution

• Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

**Role

**Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

• Project managing complex, cross-functional projects

• Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)

• Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions

• Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations

• Running workshops with senior leaders

• Building slide decks to tell a compelling message

• Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)

What You’ll Bring

• 
You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience

• 
Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus

• 
Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward

• 
Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors

• 
Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail

• 
Strong stakeholder management and team working experience

• 
Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel

• 
Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus

• 
Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus

• 
Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging

• 
A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you

• 
Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs

• 
Professionally fluent in English

What You’ll Learn

• 
There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching

• 
This could include:

• 
Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector

• 
Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way

• 
Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success

• 
Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization

• 
This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite

• 
Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too

**Working At STG & What To Expect

**At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

**Our recruitment process

****Requirements

**Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which will likely follow the following steps:

• Recruiter Screen

• Team Interview

• Behavioural Assessment

• Leadership Interview with case study

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover **so much more.

**Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Global Business Owner, Global Procurement to be based in Ballerup, Denmark

In this role, you will lead Global Procurement through our global ERP, QMS and PLM transformation, turning functional strategy into harmonized processes, clear decisions and measurable value. You will report to the Global Operations Program Director, with functional anchoring to the VP Global Procurement, and work closely with Global Process Owners, site leadership, IT, Finance, Quality and implementation partners.

This is a unique opportunity to shape a major global transformation and challenge established ways of working. It will suit an experienced procurement leader who enjoys bridging business and technology and driving change at scale.

**Key Responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Developing the transformation roadmap, target operating model and benefit case for Global Procurement

• Representing Global Procurement in program governance and making timely decisions

• Driving simplification, harmonization and adoption across sites

• Ensuring processes, data and systems meet quality and regulatory requirements

**Suggested candidate profile

****Skills

Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have leadership experience within Global Procurement

• Hold a degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Have strong knowledge of global operations and end-to-end processes

• Come from medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry

• Have delivered major business transformation or enterprise system implementations

• Have strong executive presence and can influence across functions and sites

• Have ERP, QMS or PLM experience (ideally Infor M3 or Dassault Systèmes) and are flexible to travel internationally

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Technical Services Manager – VELUX Skjern

****Are you an experienced technical leader who thrives on combining strategic direction with operational excellence? Join our production site in Skjern and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of advanced manufacturing, driving technical performance, digitalisation, and continuous improvement across a highly automated production environment.

****Meet your future team

**As Technical Manager, you will be based in Skjern and report directly to the General Manager. You will lead a diverse and highly skilled Technical Services organisation consisting of Project Engineers, Engineering Specialists within mechanical and electronic engineering and analytics, and a Maintenance team of experienced technicians. Together, the team plays a crucial role in ensuring equipment reliability, delivering technical projects, and supporting production excellence.

You will become part of both local and international leadership forums, collaborating closely with colleagues across Operations, Engineering, Quality and Production. The role offers significant influence and autonomy, enabling you to identify opportunities, drive improvements and contribute to the continued development of a mature Lean culture built on VELUX values.

A key focus in the coming years will be the optimisation of a highly automated production facility in Skjern, which will serve as a blueprint for future implementation at one of our production sites in France.

**What We Offer

**In this role, you will lead technical operations across the site while supporting the organisation's strategic ambitions around operational performance, innovation and manufacturing excellence. You will have the opportunity to influence both people and processes, ensuring that technical capabilities continue to evolve in line with business needs.

More specifically, your tasks will be to:

• Lead and develop the Technical Services organisation through values-based leadership, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, safety and technical excellence.

• Ensure high levels of equipment availability, reliability and performance across production operations.

• Develop and strengthen team capabilities within engineering, technical project management, maintenance and digitalisation.

• Drive equipment stability, process optimisation and digital transformation initiatives while delivering against operational KPIs and global standards.

• Identify, evaluate and implement innovative technologies, systems and working methods that enhance productivity, quality and efficiency.

• Support the installation, integration and optimisation of new machinery and production technologies across the site.

• Collaborate with local and international stakeholders to deliver strategic projects and share best practices across the organisation.

**What You Will Bring

**You are an experienced people leader who enjoys developing teams and creating an environment where individuals can perform at their best. You combine technical expertise with strong business understanding and are equally comfortable defining strategic priorities and ensuring successful execution.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Bring proven leadership experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment, preferably within a larger international organisation.

• Hold a relevant technical qualification such as Engineering, Production Technology, Marine Engineering or a comparable discipline.

• Have substantial experience leading technical, engineering, maintenance or project teams.

• Possess a strong understanding of Lean principles, operational excellence and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Have experience driving technical development, automation, digitalisation or production improvement initiatives.

• Communicate effectively across all organisational levels and build strong relationships based on trust, collaboration and mutual respect.

• Are fluent in English and Danish, both written and spoken.

**Ready to apply?

**Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match. All enquiries will be treated confidentially.

**About VELUX

**In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, courage and mutual respect define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

**Equal Opportunity Employer

**At VELUX Residential, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX Residential. That means we recruit, hire, train and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

**What We Achieve Together

**At Vaillant, service plays a vital role in our customers’ everyday lives. That is why we are looking for a Service Coordinator who is motivated by bringing structure to a busy workday, coordinating activities across multiple stakeholders, and ensuring a high-quality customer experience. As a key member of our Service team, you will play an important role in ensuring that our customers receive the service they expect and deserve.

In this role, you will work closely with technicians, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient and professional service delivery. You will be part of our Service team and report directly to the Technical Support Manager.

• You will plan and coordinate service visits, start-ups, and other service activities to ensure our customers receive timely and professional support.

• Through close collaboration with customers, technicians, and internal stakeholders, you will ensure that service activities are prioritized and completed efficiently.

• Your responsibilities will include managing service agreements, create work orders, and follow up on planned service activities.

• Together with the Service team, you will contribute to effective resource planning and help optimize technician utilization.

• You will coordinate spare parts and support procurement activities to ensure technicians have the necessary materials to carry out their work.

• By working proactively and maintaining a structured approach, you will contribute to continuous process improvements and high levels of customer satisfaction.

**What Makes Us Successful Together

**

• You hold a relevant administrative, commercial, or technical qualification and are motivated by working in a coordinating role

• You have experience from a service coordination, planning, customer service, or administrative position, ideally within a technical or service-oriented environment

• You have strong organizational and planning skills, work in a structured manner, and are comfortable using administrative systems and Microsoft Office applications

• Experience working within a service organization or coordinating field service technicians would be considered an advantage

• You are proactive, solution-oriented, and thrive in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and professionalism

• You are fluent in Danish, both written and spoken, and feel comfortable communicating in English within an international organization

**What You Can Count On

**

• You will be working out of our beautiful new HQs in Taastrup that have been designed to unite and inspire our teams.

• We also invite you to come and enjoy our lunch in our canteen. The restaurant offers an affordable service for all residents and visitors.

• At Vaillant, you will become part of a company with strong values, a high level of expertise, and a shared ambition to create sustainable solutions for the future of energy. We offer a collaborative and supportive work environment, opportunities for professional development, and a role where your contribution has a visible impact on both our customers and our business.

**What Makes Us Special

**We take care of a better climate. In every home and our environment. As a successful family business, we have been living up to this claim for over 150 years. We are one of the world's leading providers of heat pumps, digital services and efficient gas heating appliances and offer energy-saving solutions.

You will find sustainability everywhere at the Vaillant Group. In the office, at the production sites and on the road. Around 16,000 employees from over 70 countries are committed to this every day. As an international team, we take responsibility - for our future and that of our planet. We promote your personal development so that you can act with passion and together we can ensure a better climate.

Become part of the Vaillant Group and help us shape the future of heating!

**We promote equity and do not tolerate any form of discrimination. We value the uniqueness of each individual and encourage all people to apply.
