**Your impact begins here

**As Accounting Manager, you will take full ownership of accounting and tax activities for your area in Business Area (BA) West and become the trusted first point of contact for the local Finance & Operations (F&O) Head and Line of Business. You will keep financial reporting accurate, timely and compliant, especially at month-end and year-end, and help make accounting simpler and more digital. Your work gives local teams the clarity to make decisions and keep moving at pace.

**What You’ll Bring

**You combine strong technical accounting with the confidence to partner with the business and challenge constructively.

• A master’s degree in business, finance, economics or a similar field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience from finance, consulting, auditing or a comparable background.

• Solid experience in accounting and financial reporting, including month-end and year-end closing.

• Strong technical accounting skills and the ability to handle complex accounting matters.

• Experience performing financial controls and working within a control framework.

• Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills, with the ability to explain complex accounting topics clearly to Finance and non-Finance colleagues.

• Knowledge of SAP.

• A structured, analytical and detail-oriented approach, and the ability to prioritise and deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines.

• A proactive, collaborative mindset, with the confidence to take ownership.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be accountable for the quality of accounting in your area and a visible partner to the people who depend on it.

• Take full accounting responsibility for your assigned area, with the tax activities that go with it.

• Act as first point of contact for the local F&O Head and Line of Business, giving accounting advice and business partnering.

• Perform complex accounting tasks during month-end close (MEC) and year-end close (YEC), delivering accurate, timely and compliant financial reporting.

• Carry out financial controls and make sure control activities are completed effectively and on time.

• Investigate accounting issues, identify risks and drive them to resolution.

• Improve accounting processes and ways of working through standardisation, simplification and digitalisation.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Accounting & Taxation BA West Centre of Excellence (CoE), based in Copenhagen (Ørestad), and report to the Associate Director Accounting & Taxation CoE. The CoE is responsible for accounting and tax across nine affiliates in 11 countries: Denmark & Iceland, Sweden, Norway, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Belgium & Luxembourg, Finland, Ireland and Portugal.

The team includesAccounting Managers and controllers who act as dedicated finance partners to individual affiliates, while two positions focus on the Business Area as a whole. Your closest partners will be the local F&O Head and Line of Business for your area, alongside colleagues across the wider Accounting & Taxation organisation. Together you build standardised, efficient ways of working that support high-quality financial management.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will be trusted to own your area and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for the quality and timeliness of your work. You will grow by working across markets, stakeholders and finance disciplines, and by contributing to how accounting is improved and digitalised across Business Area West. You will be supported by colleagues who give and ask for honest feedback so that everyone can perform at their best.

• Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 650,960.00 to 956,860.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to own accounting in your area and partner with the business to deliver high-quality results, upload your CV and apply before 19.11.2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Content Specialist - PR & Journalism

Do you have a background in journalism or PR? Then you already have a head start. At Bonzer, your sense for a good story, sharp angles and solid research is exactly what makes content stand out – on Google, in the media and in the answers AI models give.

We're looking for someone who wants to be among the best content people in Scandinavia – and who sees every piece as a chance to get sharper.

About us

Bonzer is a specialised SEO agency passionate about helping businesses strengthen their online presence and visibility across Google and AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. That’s why we focus on crafting strong, organic strategies and SEO results tailored to our clients’ needs, goals and ambitions.

At Bonzer, we support our clients’ overall business and marketing strategy through in-depth analyses, strategic roadmaps and effective SEO sprints. We value close, honest and transparent relationships, both externally with our clients and internally with each other.

The role

As our new Content Specialist, you'll join a content team we're actively building and strengthening. You'll produce high-quality content for Bonzer's clients – content built to rank at the top of Google, earn coverage in the media and be visible in AI search platforms and language models.

Search is changing rapidly. More and more people find answers, products and brands through AI models. That's why journalism and PR skills are more valuable in SEO than ever. You'll work hands-on with this shift every day, helping our clients grow through organic visibility.

We want someone who's naturally drawn to exploring how new AI tools can make their day-to-day sharper. Not because someone tells you to, but because it's genuinely fun to figure out what's suddenly possible.

We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. What we expect is that you bring strong craft, high standards and the drive to keep raising the bar.

Your responsibilities

• You'll create different types of high-quality content for our clients, such as blog posts, product and category texts, press releases, and graphic and interactive formats. Every piece combines strong craftsmanship with a clear strategic purpose.

• You'll drive Digital PR for our clients: find newsworthy angles in data and client insights, pitch stories and land coverage in global media.

• You'll create content that AI models pick up, cite and trust, helping our clients become visible not only on Google but also in the answers AI search platforms give.

• You'll explore how new AI tools can make your day-to-day work sharper – and share what you learn with the team.

• You'll own your tasks from start to finish. You'll keep an overview of multiple tasks and deadlines, take responsibility for the quality of your work and contribute to your team's shared goals.

Who you are

You have experience within journalism, PR, communication, content creation or similar areas.

Above all, you're a genuinely strong writer and know what makes a story newsworthy**.** You know how to create texts that are engaging, well-structured and tailored to different audiences and formats – and you take pride in delivering quality every time, even under deadline pressure.

Experience with SEO isn't a requirement, but we want to see a genuine interest in AI search, visibility in AI models and Digital PR. Just as important, you're curious about AI as a tool, not just as a topic.

You're organised and structured, and you take responsibility for your own performance. That's why we're looking for new colleagues who thrive in a collaborative environment, value community and share our values, so that together we can strengthen each other and the company.

You have high standards for your own work – you seek out feedback, study the best in the field and enjoy improving yourself. We value your character, craftsmanship and teamwork above all.

You'll thrive here if…

• you get a kick out of seeing your story in the media or your text at the top of Google

• you see feedback as the fastest way to grow

• you like a dynamic day where no two days are the same

Language requirements: You must speak and write fluently in Danish and English, and be a resident of Denmark, as the role is based at our Copenhagen office. Excellent Danish skills are essential for creating content for our Danish clients, and English is our primary working language across markets.

What we offer

• Dedicated support from day one

• Mentorship and skill development

• Working with exciting clients and brands

• Rapid development and career opportunities

• Valuable insight into SEO and the latest developments in AI-driven search

• Responsibility and independent tasks from day one

• Close collaboration with experienced and specialised colleagues

• A strong team culture with regular events and activities

• A growing team of 50 specialists across Denmark, Sweden and Norway

• An office in the centre of Copenhagen

How to apply

If you are interested in the role of Content Specialist at Bonzer, please upload your CV.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait. Expected start: December 2026.

We will get back to you directly if we see a potential match and invite you to a short introductory interview.

The recruitment process consists of the following steps:

• First interview

• Second interview with case

• Final interview

We look forward to receiving your application!

Best regards,

Team Bonzer

Department: Global Manufacturing & Supply – CMC Clinical Supplies, Digital Solutions

Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As IT Project Manager, you will lead complex IT projects that keep the GxP systems behind Clinical Supplies reliable, compliant and ready for what comes next. By aligning business, IT, Quality and vendors, you help deliver the systems that support clinical trial supply, on time and in line with regulatory requirements. You will turn complex dependencies into clear plans and decisions, so specialist teams can focus on delivery.

**What You’ll Bring

**You have led complex IT projects from start to finish and know how to deliver in a highly governed setting.

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in IT, engineering, life sciences, business, supply chain or a related field.

• Extensive experience managing cross-functional IT projects, with genuine end-to-end ownership of scope, timeline, budget and risks.

• Experience delivering projects that involve multiple systems, organisational areas and external vendors.

• Experience managing system integrations, APIs, interfaces and data exchange between enterprise systems. You do not need to be a developer, but you understand the technology well enough to manage dependencies and risks.

• Experience working in a regulated environment. Pharma, life sciences and medical devices are relevant, and so are banking, energy, defence and other highly controlled industries.

• Experience coordinating testing, validation, documentation, change control and implementation activities.

• You navigate diverse stakeholder interests, build alignment and drive collaboration across technical teams, business functions and senior management.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

• Experience with project governance, budget follow-up, resource planning and status reporting, including clear communication of project status and costs to stakeholders.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience with MES (for example PAS-X), Interactive Response Technology, Computer System Validation, GAMP 5 or regulated cloud and SaaS solutions.

• A recognised project management certification, such as PRINCE2 or PMP.

• Experience combining agile ways of working with structured project governance.

**What You’ll Do

**You will own delivery of IT projects in a regulated GxP environment, creating structure and keeping everyone moving in the same direction.

• Lead projects from initiation and planning through implementation to structured handover to system ownership, support and business operations.

• Drive integration and API projects between GxP and business-critical systems, aligning requirements, solution design, interfaces and data flows.

• Manage scope, milestones, budget, resources, risks, dependencies and decisions.

• Coordinate testing, validation, release readiness and cutover, making sure deliverables meet GxP, quality, security and privacy requirements.

• Manage vendor deliverables and performance together with Procurement and relevant internal functions.

• Give senior stakeholders transparent reporting and clear decision material, and lead business readiness, training and procedural updates.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the IT team for GxP systems within Clinical Supplies, part of Global Manufacturing & Supply in CMC. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them.

Your team is based in Denmark and works closely with colleagues in India, while a sister team looks after non-GxP systems. Across the systems landscape, around 40 IT professionals may be involved in your projects, together with external partners.

Day to day, you will partner with Product Owners, System Managers, Solution Architects, developers, validation specialists, Quality Assurance and business representatives. A fellow Project Manager will be your peer and sparring partner.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a role with real ownership. You will step into a project that is already moving, with a growing pipeline of IT projects behind it, and you will be trusted to shape how it is delivered. You will have a peer Project Manager to learn from and challenge your thinking, and the chance to broaden your skills across systems, vendors and functions. Clear expectations and honest feedback help you perform at your best.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000 to 956,900 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring structure and momentum to complex GxP integration projects, apply for the IT Project Manager role by 13 November 2026. Please submit your CV in English. We review applications as they arrive, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Drive portfolio governance, shape portfolio management and act as Business Product Owner for Ambu’s project and portfolio management system, XPM.

Ambu A/S is looking for a Project Portfolio Management Specialist to join the Innovation PMO in Ballerup, Denmark.

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will play a key role in strengthening how Ambu prioritizes, plans and governs its product development portfolio. You will drive portfolio governance, act as Business Product Owner for Ambu’s project and portfolio management platform (XPM), and translate insights from across R&D into system and process improvements that support better decision-making, portfolio transparency and execution.

Working with Project Managers, Line Managers, Finance and IT, you will connect decisions on product development projects and resources with how projects are planned, prioritized, and followed up.

You will join an Innovation PMO working across portfolio governance, planning, systems and process improvements. Together with colleagues responsible for other PMO systems and processes, you will help evolve how portfolio management is supported across R&D, ensuring governance, systems and planning processes continue to meet the needs of a growing organization.

The role offers the opportunity to deepen your experience in portfolio governance, business-system product ownership and cross-functional improvement, while working closely with stakeholders ranging from project teams and functional managers to senior leadership.

**Key Responsibilities

****Portfolio Governance

**

• Drive portfolio governance through Solution Steering Committee and Gate meetings, ensuring high-quality decision material, clear prioritization and effective follow-through on decisions

• Review and challenge project change requests and business cases, ensuring robust decision material and alignment with key stakeholders before submission

**Business Product Owner, XPM

**

• Own the XPM development and maintenance backlog; prioritize requirements from project managers, line managers, portfolio management and Finance

• Align updates with IT requirements and drive delivery through the IT system owner and XPM vendor

• Train R&D users, maintain XPM guidance and align XPM use with Product Owners of other PMO systems

**Cross-Functional Planning & Continuous Improvement

**

• Facilitate quarterly cross-functional planning, resource alignment and project forecasting; record decisions, action owners and deadlines.

• Onboard project managers and line managers on portfolio governance, submission requirements, approval mandates and escalation routes.

• Identify recurring decision-preparation, planning and follow-up issues; agree and implement improvements with process owners.

**Your Experience And Skills

**You are likely to succeed in this role if you:

• Have 5+ years of experience in project management, PMO, portfolio governance, project portfolio management or a related field

• Have experience translating business needs into system requirements and supported testing and implementation

• Have facilitated cross-functional planning and resource alignment and financial forecasting discussions

• Have worked closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and/or system vendors

• Can challenge incomplete decision material, secure follow-up across functions and communicate clearly in English

• Have a curious and proactive mindset, with the ability to identify improvement opportunities and translate insights into practical solutions

Experience with business-system product ownership, XPM or comparable PPM systems, and MedTech or another regulated industry is an advantage.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Financial Controller - Take ownership of business-critical financial topics
jobs.description:
_**Would you like to play a key role in driving high-quality financial control, governance, and technical accounting across an international Group – with flexibility in how you structure your work?

**_Working on complex and business-critical topics, including audits, IFRS, acquisitions, and financial reporting, you will influence processes, shape best practices, and strengthen governance frameworks and internal controls across the Group.

Join us and build your expertise in a leading international healthcare company dedicated to improving the lives of people with intimate healthcare needs worldwide.

**Our Group Controlling and Reporting team is ready to welcome you

**At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will become part of the Group Controlling and Reporting team within Corporate Finance. Here, you will join a close-knit team of seven colleagues who support subsidiaries across the globe and are responsible for reviews, reporting, and controlling activities. We foster a friendly, inclusive, and professional environment with a high degree of flexibility, where collaboration is strong, new ideas are always welcomed and heard, and we make a point of having fun together when we come to work.

**Be the key finance partner across the Group

**As Senior Financial Controller, you will serve as a key finance partner across the Group, providing expertise within IFRS, technical accounting, financial controlling, and governance.

This entails acting as a subject matter expert on complex accounting areas and being the finance contact towards acquired entities. You will also be the one to strengthen internal controls and governance frameworks.

Specifically, you will:

• Prepare accounting memorandums, supporting key accounting positions.

• Act as contact towards external auditors and prepare audit documentation.

• Own PPA preparation and follow-up in connection with acquisitions.

• Perform monthly controlling of subsidiaries and key business areas.

• Execute financial reviews and drive follow-up on identified risks.

• Handle and prepare annual reports together with the team for both the Group and the parent company.

**You combine strong financial expertise with a business-oriented mindset

**In this role, you need to have the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, taking ownership of activities and projects as well as engaging and collaborating with stakeholders across functions and geographies. Also, your exceptional business insight and perceptive mindset enable you to effectively organise and prioritise tasks, while identifying practical solutions to complex challenges.

Finally, we imagine that you:

• Hold an MSc in Business Administration and Auditing (cand.merc.aud.) or a Bachelor of Commerce (HD).

• Have solid experience from a similar role, for example, as an auditor, financial controller, risk & control consultant, or operational control & compliance manager.

• May have experience from an accountancy firm, though this is an advantage and not a prerequisite.

• Possess a deep understanding of financial statements and accounting, including identifying issues and solutions.

• Have strong knowledge of the technical aspects of IFRS.

• Are fluent in English.

**Interested?

**If you would like to know more about this position, please contact Senior Director, Jesper S. Lauesen at dkjgh@coloplast.com

We continuously review applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

_Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

__Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

__Visit us on Coloplast.com.

__Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

Welltec is looking for a motivated Accounting Assistant to become part of our dynamic HQ accounting team based in Allerød.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

Welltec is looking for a motivated Accounting Assistant to become part of our dynamic HQ accounting team based in Allerød. Our HQ accounting team comprises 10 talented professionals from diverse backgrounds and nationalities, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

In addition to accounting, the finance department is structured into four other specialized teams: Financial Planning & Analysis, Group Reporting, Treasury, and Tax. Together, these teams work cohesively to support the organization’s financial health and strategic objectives.

The position

You will be actively involved in the daily operational tasks and have a portfolio of own responsibilities. This blend of responsibilities will ensure a dynamic and enriching work experience.

Key responsibilities

• Input, update, and verify data in accounting systems with attention to detail

• Process and control travel expenses and export/import in ERP-systems

• Perform bank, account, and ledger reconciliations to ensure accuracy

• Monitor shared mailboxes

• Assist in identifying and resolving discrepancies in financial records

• Maintain approval flows in systems

• Participate in optimization projects

• Supporting team members whenever deemed relevant

The candidate

We’re looking for someone who has a strong sense of ownership, is service minded and a team player and have a positive attitude, are curious and eager to investigate and broaden the horizon and a good communicator.

We imagine that you:

• Have a track record within similar work +2 years

• If you have a relevant basic-level education, e.g. finalised trainee within accounting and economics (Økonomielev) this will be a plus

• Basic accounting skills, eg. debet/credit and chart of accounts

•  IT application skills, including MS Office, ERP-systems, vendor invoice processing systems and expense systems

• Speak and write English fluently and understanding Danish is an advantage

• Work in a structured way, with the necessary attention to details

• Adhere to deadlines while keeping an overview

•  Have inherent high business ethics

• Have a forthcoming personality and are a good team mate

Within 1 month you will:

• Settle in and get to know your new colleagues in the HQ Finance department located in Allerød

• Get introduced to the tasks and start learning the processes

Within 3 months you will:

• Run daily tasks independently

• Start building knowledge about maintaining the systems

• Start learning about the business set-up and finance processes

Within 9 months you will:

• Be experienced within the daily processes

• Participate actively in optimization processes

• Keep broaden the horizon within the company and global environment

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.
